primitives.name: Scoring Mechanics
primitives.verbatim_quote: RULES AND SUGGESTIONS 299 obtained by touchdown, 6 points; goal from field-kick, either a dropkick or place-kick, 4 points; touchdown failing goal, 5 points; safety by opponents, 2 points.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T': 'touchdown points = 6', 'G': 'goal from field-kick points = 4', 'F': 'touchdown failing goal points = 5', 'S': 'safety by opponents points = 2'}
primitives.assumptions: Points are additive and exclusive per event type; no fractional scoring.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T = F + 1, implies goal kick contributes 1 additional point beyond touchdown.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI probabilistic scoring models where P(T) = 6, P(G) = 4, etc., forming a discrete reward function over actions.

primitives.name: Equipment Safety Constraints
primitives.verbatim_quote: (a) No one having projecting nails or iron plates on his shoes or any projecting metallic or hard substance on his person shall be allowed to play in a match.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{safe}': 'safe equipment status = boolean', 'M_{proj}': 'projecting metal objects = set', 'P_{body}': 'player body parts = set'}
primitives.assumptions: All players must pass inspection before match start.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Disqualification occurs if E_safe = false due to M_proj ∩ P_body ≠ ∅.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE constraint satisfaction problem (CSP), where each player's gear is validated against a safety kernel.

primitives.name: Substitution Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: (b) A player may be substituted for another at any time at the discretion of the captain of his team.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{in}': 'substitute entering = boolean', 'C_{captain}': 'team captain authority = boolean', 'T_{time}': 'time of substitution = scalar'}
primitives.assumptions: Substitution requires captain approval and immediate referee notification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: S_in = true iff C_captain = true and T_time ∈ [start, end].

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE dynamic team state transitions, modeling substitution as a control input affecting player roles and performance metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Player swap timestamps and referee validation logs.
